en.help.mesh.align_landmarks: Pick three corresponding pairs of surface points on the moving and fixed scans. A rigid fit aligns the landmarks and reports the remaining error.
en.help.mesh.align_datum: Pick an origin, a point on positive X and a point toward positive Y on one scan to place it in world coordinates.
en.help.mesh.align_coarse: Choose the moving and fixed scan for automatic coarse rigid registration. Use Fine Align Scans to refine the result.
en.help.mesh.align_plane_to_csys: Place a scan so its chosen construction plane coincides with world XY, XZ or YZ. Flip normal to reverse the direction.
